cadence.signal_inference: once per newly closed execution candle
cadence.execution_gate: every candidate order using current spread/slippage state
cadence.daily_review: after market/session close; review only, no direct promotion

promotion.activation_boundary: next newly closed execution candle after approval

roles.github: canonical code/config/model-report registry; PR and Human-Gate evidence
roles.local_or_vps: heavy training, walk-forward, cost-surface, Monte Carlo and shadow scoring
roles.n8n: scheduler/orchestrator/notification layer only; never canonical model state
roles.cloudflare: lightweight policy/state API, health and HOLD/ALLOW status; no heavy training
